from: 2. A credit of $200 with $80 applied to an invoice
to: 2. A credit that has been partly used up against an invoice - for example a $200 credit with $80 of it applied. To make one: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer that has an unpaid invoice worth LESS than the credit you are about to give and that has no deposit on the account (the payment window uses a deposit before it uses a credit), click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type the amount, choose "Issue Store Credit", type a short note and confirm. Then tick the new credit's row and the unpaid invoice's row together, click "New Payment", leave the invoice's "Payment" box at its full balance, choose any "Payment method" if "Make payment" is greyed out, and click "Make payment". The credit's own row in that window says what will happen to it, for example "Applies $80.00 · $120.00 remaining", and afterwards its "Status" reads "Partially applied".
